info.description:
#  OpenAssistant Conversations Dataset (OASST1)

## Overview
OpenAssistant Conversations (OASST1) is a **human-generated, human-annotated** assistant-style conversation corpus collected from **13,500+ volunteers worldwide**  via the open-assistant.io platform. It contains **161,443 messages** across **66,497 conversation trees** in **35 languages**, with **461,292 quality ratings**  making it one of the most richly annotated open-source AI conversation datasets available.

This dataset is ideal for **LLM fine-tuning**, **reward model training**, **conversation analysis**, and **AI safety research**.

##  Dataset Info

| Property | Details |
|---|---|
| **Source** | HuggingFace — OpenAssistant |
| **URL** | huggingface.co/datasets/OpenAssistant/oasst1 |
| **Total Messages** | 161,443 |
| **Conversation Trees** | 66,497 |
| **Languages** | 35 |
| **Volunteers** | 13,500+ worldwide |
| **Quality Ratings** | 461,292 |
| **Train Split** | 84,437 messages |
| **Validation Split** | 4,401 messages |
| **License** | Apache 2.0 |
| **Data Collected** | Until April 12, 2023 |

##  Top Languages

| Language | Code |
|---|---|
| English | en |
| German | de |
| Spanish | es |
| French | fr |
| Chinese | zh |
| Russian | ru |
| Portuguese | pt |
| + 28 more | ... |

##  Dataset Structure
The dataset uses a **tree structure** where each conversation starts with a root prompt and branches into multiple assistant replies. Messages alternate strictly between `prompter` and `assistant` roles. Trees can be reconstructed using `parent_id` and `message_id` fields.


## ⚠️ Ethical Notice
This dataset contains real human-written conversations and has been filtered for PII. However, some conversations may contain sensitive or controversial content. It is intended strictly for **research and educational purposes**. Please review the Apache 2.0 license terms before commercial use.
